dataset_purpose: Reference methodology documentation for household and industrial carbon calculations scoped to Ernakulam district, Kerala. This database is intended to support verified direct CO2 calculations only and is not a complete greenhouse-gas inventory.

geographic_scope.scope_note: Industrial calculations are restricted to Ernakulam district. National default electricity and fuel factors are retained only as clearly labelled national or grid-level defaults and are not treated as Ernakulam-specific local factors.

data_sources.source_organisation: Central Electricity Authority (CEA), Ministry of Power, Government of India
data_sources.methodology_note: This is the weighted-average national grid factor, not an operating margin, build margin, or combined margin factor. It is a national default and is not Ernakulam-specific.

data_sources.source_document: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories, Volume 2: Energy
data_sources.methodology_note: Direct CO2 combustion factors are used for petrol, diesel and LPG. These are generic defaults and exclude CH4 and N2O.

calculation_boundaries.scope: This reference dataset supports direct CO2 emissions and purchased electricity emissions only.
calculation_boundaries.household_boundary: Household electricity and fuel use are treated as monthly consumption inputs. Annualised values are calculated as monthly values multiplied by 12 and must be labelled as estimates.
calculation_boundaries.industrial_boundary: Industrial Scope 1 includes direct combustion of supported fuels. Industrial Scope 2 includes purchased electricity. Process emissions, waste emissions and feedstock emissions are excluded.
calculation_boundaries.waste_boundary: Waste factors are intentionally excluded unless an appropriate methodology and activity data are available and explicitly added.
calculation_boundaries.co2_vs_co2e: All factors in this dataset are CO2-only factors. Results are not labelled as full CO2e because CH4 and N2O are not included.

assumptions: Petrol and diesel values are generic defaults converted from standard fuel properties and are not local fuel-specification measurements.
LPG is calculated using the IPCC default CO2 factor of 63,100 kg CO2/TJ and LPG net calorific value of 47.3 MJ/kg.
Electricity uses the official CEA national weighted-average location-based grid factor for FY 2025-26.
Annualised values are estimates derived from the reported month, not measured annual emissions.
known_limitations: No district-specific electricity factor for Ernakulam has been identified in the reviewed official sources.
No district-specific industrial fuel mix or technology factor has been identified.
The database does not include complete greenhouse-gas accounting because CH4 and N2O are excluded.
This dataset is intended for transparent estimation and reporting, not for audited facility emissions claims.

verified_sources: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories, Volume 2: Energy
pending_verification: District-specific industrial fuel mix and process factors.
Waste emissions factors and any additional Scope 3 categories.
